hold.reason: Zero confirmed-green candidates. Omission from truncated context is not evidence of eligibility; no merge order is authorized.
Resolve the actual review, protection, or check cause, then obtain fresh GitHub verification at the final head. Never force or bypass.
Update the branch, then re-verify checks, reviews, commit status, and protections at the resulting head.
Resolve merge conflicts, then obtain fresh verified-green evidence at the resulting head.
Failing or pending checks and unverified heads are not green; fix genuine causes and re-verify.
CLEAN alone is insufficient. Hold until required checks and commit status succeed, with reviews and protections satisfied at the final head.
Audit the diff: enlarging a readiness-probe bound to accept a 9.7KiB campaign may be check-shaping; later green does not cure an unaudited band-aid.
Retry-on-stale-readback is a rerun-to-green risk; prove admission is never relaxed and obtain required review and check verification.
Audit before green: failure-precedence reordering could mask real SHA drift.

plan.notes: Empty GO is the honest fail-closed result. After genuine fixes, admit only freshly verified-green PRs, dependency-first and one at a time; revalidate head, reviews, checks, and protections after every merge. Never force, bypass, edit protections, use empty-commit retriggers, or rerun merely to obtain green.
